title: tc-decision-inbox
description: Open decisions with two quick answers each; answered ones confirm, then fold away.

heading.description: The inbox's name, in the header; the line under it says how many need input

decisions.description: The decisions to show – new ones join as they're passed, answered ones fold away

answers.description: The answers given so far, by decision id. Answers present on first render start folded away. Changed by the user unless a tc-answers-change listener calls preventDefault()

primary.description: Main answer, shown as the dark button

secondary.description: Other answer, shown as the light button

collapsed.description: Starts folded to one muted line – click to open
